name: Tocatli
description: The imperial citadel in Pachatupa converted to a war room.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: As an eight-year-old, Huatli asks a priest what is on the far side of the sun and is told it doesn't matter (flashback).
timeline.quote: What's on the far side of the sun?

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The priest explains the duty of a warrior-poet to tell others' truths (flashback).
timeline.quote: It means that when you tell stories, you are telling someone's truth.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: In the imperial war room, the emperor learns his fleet of ten thousand is lost and Caparocti warns of unnatural storms.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Commanders report the collapse of the empire's defenses as Phyrexians ring Pachatupa.
timeline.quote: This was not a war: it was a collapse, seeking its end point.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Huatli proposes calling the elder dinosaurs to Orazca to draw the Phyrexians from Pachatupa.
timeline.quote: I will call the elder dinosaurs to Orazca,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The emperor silences Caparocti's objections and approves Huatli's gambit.
timeline.quote: Your desire to protect the heart of our empire is admirable, but be silent.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.
